description: Audit the color tokens of a DESIGN.md file (Google Labs design-system format: YAML front matter / ```yaml blocks with `colors` and `components`). Checks WCAG + APCA contrast for pairs declared in components (backgroundColor/textColor) and pairs inferred from token names (on-X ↔ X, text ↔ surface), color-blind collisions between accent/status colors, exact and near-duplicate tokens, disliked colors, broken {colors.x} references and a missing `primary`. Suggests same-hue fixes for failing pairs. Pass the file's full text.

cvdThreshold.description: ΔE2000 below which two accent/status colors count as indistinguishable under color-vision deficiency

designMd.description: Full text of the DESIGN.md file

maxItems.description: Maximum rows listed per report section

textThreshold.description: Minimum WCAG contrast for text pairs (4.5 = AA normal text, 7 = AAA)

name: audit_design_md
